info.title: Headless LMS API
info.description: API documentation for the Headless LMS platform

post.summary: Create an organization and make it active
post.description: For any signed-in person, including one with no organization yet. The caller becomes its owner.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Owner or admin. Changes its name or slug; 409 when the slug is taken.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the organization's team members (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). The team: everyone in the organization who is not a student.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Owner or admin only. The owner role can be neither granted nor changed (409), and only a moderator can become a student.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.description: Owner or admin only. Removing a pending member cancels their invite. The owner cannot be removed (409).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Invite a member or student into the active organization (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. A student is created by this call, so their access can be granted before they accept. 409 when a student with that email is already in the organization.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Read an invite by its token
get.description: Public: no session needed. The same 404 answers forged, expired and accepted tokens, so a probe learns nothing.

post.summary: Accept an invite with the signed-in account
post.description: For any signed-in person whose email matches the invitation. Makes the invite's organization the session's active one. 400 when the token is invalid or expired, or the email does not match.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List courses (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Every course in the organization, drafts included, filtered by status and category and searched by title.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Create a course (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). The course starts as a draft. 409 when its slug is taken.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Get a course (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Changes only the fields sent. `thumbnailAssetId` must be a ready library image (409 otherwise); null clears it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Merges the settings sent into the current ones.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List communities (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Pages every community in the organization, drafts included, filtered by `status` and searched by title.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Create a community (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. The community starts as a draft with the default direct-message settings and no spaces. Members see it once it is published and they hold it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Get a community (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Any community of the organization, drafts included.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Owner or admin only. Changes only the fields sent. `thumbnailAssetId` must be a ready library image (409 otherwise); null clears it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.description: Owner or admin only. Links to the community from other spaces are removed with it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.summary: Change direct-message settings for a community (staff)
patch.description: Owner or admin only. Changes only the settings sent; the rest keep their values. They decide who may message whom from then on.

groupSize.description: The most people a group chat may hold, its creator included

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Publish a community (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. Makes the community visible to the people who hold it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Unpublish a community (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. Hides the community from members again; nothing in it is deleted.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Staff analytics for a community
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Membership, activity and moderation counts for one community.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Open message flags in a community (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). The messages in the community's chats with open flags, with the flags and the chat each is in. Holds at most the 100 oldest open flags; working the queue brings in the next ones.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the spaces in a community (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Every space in order, with its topics and links.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Create a space (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. The space is added last. An `all_members` space cannot have a capacity (409).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

put.summary: Reorder the spaces in a community (staff)
put.description: Owner or admin only. Send every space id of the community exactly once (409 otherwise).

ids.description: Every id in the collection, once each, in the new order

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Get a space (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). The space with its topics and links.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Owner or admin only. Changes only the fields sent; `settings` merges into the current settings. An `all_members` space cannot have a capacity (409).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.description: Owner or admin only. The space and everything in it go.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

put.summary: Replace the topics on a space (staff)
put.description: Owner or admin only. The list replaces the current topics: an entry with an `id` keeps and renames that topic, one without adds a topic, and a topic left out is deleted. Names must be unique (409), and a topic that posts use cannot be deleted (409).

id.description: Keep an existing topic; omit to add a new one

topics.description: The complete list, in order. A topic left out is deleted

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Link a course, download, or community into a space (staff)
post.description: Owner or admin only. The link is added last. Linking the same content twice is a 409.

contentId.description: The course, download or community to link

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.summary: Remove a link from a space (staff)
delete.description: Owner or admin only. The linked content itself is untouched.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

put.summary: Reorder the links in a space (staff)
put.description: Owner or admin only. Send every link id of the space exactly once (409 otherwise).

ids.description: Every id in the collection, once each, in the new order

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the people who hold a community (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Everyone with active access to the community, granted directly or through a bundle, paged and searched by name or email.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the members, requests and invitations of a space (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). The space's members, its open requests to join and its open invitations.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Add a person to a space (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Places a member of the community straight into the space, with no request or invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members, the person is already placed, or the space is full.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Invite a person into a space (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Invites a member of the community into a `by_invite` space; they join when they accept. 403 when the person is staff or does not hold the community; 409 when the space is not invite-only or the person is already placed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Approve a person's request to join a space (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Makes the requester an active member. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when the space is full or they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Decline a person's request to join a space (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Closes the open request. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a person from a space (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Revokes the placement, whether it is a membership, a request or an invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members or the placement is already revoked.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: The moderation queue of a space (staff)
get.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Posts awaiting review, and the open flags on posts and on comments in the space. Each list holds at most the 100 oldest entries: pending posts by creation, flags by when they were raised; working the queue brings in the next ones.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Publish a post that is awaiting review (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). 409 when the post is not awaiting review.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a post (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Takes a published or pending post down and resolves its open flags as `removed`. 409 when it is already removed or was never submitted.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Restore a removed post (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). 409 when the post is not removed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a post (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Closes every open flag on the post and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the post up. Removing the post resolves its flags as `removed` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a comment on a post (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Hides the comment and resolves its open flags as `removed`. Removing a removed comment returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Restore a removed comment on a post (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Publishes the comment again. Restoring a comment that is not removed returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a comment (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Closes every open flag on the comment and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the comment up. Removing the comment resolves its flags as `removed` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a message (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Closes every open flag on the message and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the message up. Deleting the message or locking the chat resolves its flags as `deleted` or `locked` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Lock a chat (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Nobody can send or edit messages until it is unlocked; its open message flags are resolved as `locked`. Locking a locked chat returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Unlock a chat (staff)
post.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Lets participants send messages again. Unlocking an unlocked chat returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Changes only the fields sent. `thumbnailAssetId` must be a ready library image (409 otherwise); null clears it.

delete.description: Staff only (owner, admin, instructor). Its library files survive.

get.summary: Get the portal org's public identity (branding)
get.description: For any signed-in person whose session has this organization active. Name and slug only.

get.summary: Get the caller's identity within the session's org
get.description: For a member of the organization: your org user id, which the member API keys on, and your role here.

get.summary: Read your profile
get.description: For any signed-in person. The profile is yours across organizations; `imageUrl` is set only when the photo was uploaded in this organization. Before you save one, every field is empty.

patch.description: For a member of the organization. Changes only the fields sent; null clears one. 404 when `imageAssetId` is not a finalized image you uploaded here.

imageAssetId.description: A finalized image you uploaded through `requestMemberUpload`; null clears it

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: The spaces a member can see in a community
get.description: For a member of the community. Lists its spaces in order. Spaces the viewer can open come back in full; spaces they can see but not open come back locked, with only their name, count, rule and the viewer's standing. A by-invite space the viewer is not invited to or a member of is left out. 404 when the viewer is not a member.

standing.description: Where the viewer stands with this space, and so which action it offers. `open`: the viewer can open it without joining (an all-members space, or staff). `member`: the viewer belongs to it. `requested`: the viewer asked to join and awaits a decision. `invited`: the viewer may accept or refuse an invitation. `full`: it is at capacity. `none`: none of these; ask to join a `by_request` space, or wait for an invitation to a `by_invite` one.

locked.description: The viewer cannot open this space. Only enough to request a place, accept an invite or contact staff is served; never its description, topics, links or settings

standing.description: Where the viewer stands with this space, and so which action it offers. `open`: the viewer can open it without joining (an all-members space, or staff). `member`: the viewer belongs to it. `requested`: the viewer asked to join and awaits a decision. `invited`: the viewer may accept or refuse an invitation. `full`: it is at capacity. `none`: none of these; ask to join a `by_request` space, or wait for an invitation to a `by_invite` one.

locked.description: The viewer can open this space and read its feed

links.description: Linked content that is published; staff also see unpublished targets

items.description: A space as the viewer sees it. A by-invite space the viewer is not invited to or a member of is never served

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: One space as a member sees it
get.description: For a member of the community: the space with its topics, links, settings and where the viewer stands. A space the viewer cannot open comes back locked, without its content. 404 when the viewer is not a member, the space is not in the community, or it is a by-invite space the viewer is not invited to or a member of.

200.description: A space as the viewer sees it. A by-invite space the viewer is not invited to or a member of is never served

standing.description: Where the viewer stands with this space, and so which action it offers. `open`: the viewer can open it without joining (an all-members space, or staff). `member`: the viewer belongs to it. `requested`: the viewer asked to join and awaits a decision. `invited`: the viewer may accept or refuse an invitation. `full`: it is at capacity. `none`: none of these; ask to join a `by_request` space, or wait for an invitation to a `by_invite` one.

locked.description: The viewer cannot open this space. Only enough to request a place, accept an invite or contact staff is served; never its description, topics, links or settings

standing.description: Where the viewer stands with this space, and so which action it offers. `open`: the viewer can open it without joining (an all-members space, or staff). `member`: the viewer belongs to it. `requested`: the viewer asked to join and awaits a decision. `invited`: the viewer may accept or refuse an invitation. `full`: it is at capacity. `none`: none of these; ask to join a `by_request` space, or wait for an invitation to a `by_invite` one.

locked.description: The viewer can open this space and read its feed

links.description: Linked content that is published; staff also see unpublished targets

schema.description: A space as the viewer sees it. A by-invite space the viewer is not invited to or a member of is never served

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: People in a community
get.description: For a member of the community: everyone who holds it, with their public profile. 404 when the viewer is not a member.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches part of a display name

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the members of a space
get.description: For anyone who can open the space. Members see the active members; moderators also see open requests and invitations.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Add a person to a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who is a member of the community. Places another member straight into the space, with no request or invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members, the person is already placed, or the space is full.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Ask to join a space
post.description: For a member of the community who is not staff. Opens a request on a `by_request` space for a moderator to approve. 409 when the space is not `by_request` or you are already placed in it.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Invite a person into a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who is a member of the community. Invites another member into a `by_invite` space; they join when they accept. 403 when the person is staff or does not hold the community; 409 when the space is not invite-only or the person is already placed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Accept your invitation to a space
post.description: For a member of the community who is not staff. Makes you an active member. 409 when you have no open invitation, are already a member, or the space is full.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Approve a person's request to join a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who is a member of the community. Makes the requester an active member. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when the space is full or they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Decline a person's request to join a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who is a member of the community. Closes the open request. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Refuse your invitation to a space
post.description: For a member of the community who is not staff. 409 when you have no open invitation or are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Leave a space
post.description: For a member of the community who is not staff. 409 when you are not a member of the space.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a person from a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who is a member of the community. Revokes the placement, whether it is a membership, a request or an invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members or the placement is already revoked.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Published posts across the spaces you can open
get.description: For a member of the community. Pinned posts first, then newest first. 404 when you are not a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Your own posts in a community, newest first
get.description: For a member of the community. Your posts in any status, drafts included, in the spaces you can open. 404 when you are not a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: The posts you bookmarked in a community, newest bookmark first
get.description: For a member of the community. Only posts you can still read. 404 when you are not a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Published posts in a space
get.description: For anyone who can open the space (403 otherwise). Filter by `topicId`; an unknown topic is a 404.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: The moderation queue of a space you moderate
get.description: For a moderator who can open the space. Posts awaiting review, and the open flags on posts and on comments in the space. Each list holds at most the 100 oldest entries: pending posts by creation, flags by when they were raised; working the queue brings in the next ones.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Create a post
post.description: For anyone who can open the space. `mode` decides the status: `draft`, `scheduled`, or on `submit` `published`, or `pending` when the space requires review and you are not staff. 409 when the space has topics and none is given, or a schedule is missing or in the past.

topicId.description: One of the space's topics. Required when the space has topics, else null

coverAssetId.description: A finalized image you uploaded through `requestMemberUpload`

mode.description: `draft` keeps the post to yourself. `submit` publishes it, or holds it for review when the space requires review and you are not staff. `schedule` submits it at `scheduledAt`.

scheduledAt.description: When a scheduled post is submitted. Required, and in the future, when `mode` is `schedule`; ignored otherwise.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: Read a post
get.description: For anyone who can open the space while the post is published; for its author in any status; for moderators also while it is pending or removed. Any other post is a 404.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

patch.description: Author only. Changes only the fields sent. 409 when the post is removed, or the topic rules of the space are not met.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Submit your draft or scheduled post
post.description: Author only. Publishes it now, or holds it for review when the space requires review and you are not staff. 409 when the post is not a draft or scheduled.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Schedule your post
post.description: Author only. The post is submitted at `scheduledAt`. 409 when it is already submitted or removed, or the time is not in the future.

scheduledAt.description: When the post is submitted; must be in the future

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove your post, or one in a space you moderate
post.description: For the author or a moderator. Takes a published or pending post down; a moderator removing someone else's post resolves its open flags as `removed`. 409 when it is already removed or was never submitted.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Restore a removed post in a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator who can open the space. 409 when the post is not removed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Pin a post in a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator. Pinned posts lead the feeds. 409 when the post is removed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Unpin a post in a space you moderate
post.description: For a moderator. 409 when the post is removed.
